nodes.description: Address of the contract administrator, set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the authorization gate for addFounder.
Running total of tokens allocated to founders; incremented in addFounder and capped by totalAmountTimelocked.
Public mapping(address => Founder) tracking each founder's totalAmountLocked and amountWithdrawn.
Immutable timelock start timestamp initialized from block.timestamp in the constructor.
Immutable maximum amount (50000000000000) that can be locked and withdrawn in total.
Running total withdrawn across all founders; updated after the external token transfer in withdraw.
Private mapping(uint256 => uint256) of cumulative withdrawal percentage per weekly unlock day, populated by _setWithdrawalSchedule.
Initializes start from block.timestamp, admin from msg.sender, and populates the withdrawal schedule.
Internal loop that writes ten-percent increments into percentageAvailableByDays every 7 days until 100%.
Admin-only function that registers a founder, validates uniqueness and the global allocation cap, and updates state.
Empty payable receive function that lets the contract accept Ether.
Founder withdrawal function that computes the vested percentage from elapsed days and performs an external token transfer followed by state updates.
Read-only helper returning the totalAmountLocked for a given founder.
Read-only helper computing the standard withdrawal day from an arbitrary days-elapsed argument and returning the available percentage.
Read-only helper returning the amount available to msg.sender for a supplied percentage.
Read-only helper returning the amount already withdrawn by msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for admin assignment, admin checks, founder lookups and withdrawal authorization.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used to set start and to gate and compute time-based withdrawal percentages.
External call IERC20(token).transfer(owner, amountAvailableForWithdrawal) to an attacker-supplied token address, executed before state updates.
Subtractions in withdraw (elapsed days minus 7, and amountAvailableToOwner minus amountWithdrawn) that can revert or be manipulated by timing.
Unsigned subtraction (_daysElapsed - 7) in checkAvailability that underflows for any _daysElapsed below 7.
Founder address parameter of addFounder.
Amount to lock for the founder, parameter of addFounder.
Caller-supplied ERC20 token address parameter of withdraw.
Founder address parameter of checkFounderAllocation.
Days elapsed parameter of checkAvailability.
Percentage parameter of checkAmountAvailable.
Local in withdraw holding block.timestamp - start.
Local in withdraw holding currentElapsedTime / 86400.
Local in withdraw holding the rounded weekly withdrawal day used to index percentageAvailableByDays.
Local in withdraw holding the percentage looked up for the owner.
Local in withdraw holding percentage multiplied by the founder's locked amount over 100.
Local in withdraw holding the amount available minus the amount already withdrawn; passed to the token transfer.
Local in withdraw set to msg.sender and used as the transfer recipient.
Loop accumulator in _setWithdrawalSchedule incremented by 10 each iteration.
Loop counter in _setWithdrawalSchedule starting at day 7 and advancing by 7.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, making the privileged role caller-controlled at deployment.
start is initialized from block.timestamp, so all vesting timing depends on miner-influenceable time.
withdraw gates and computes the withdrawal percentage from block.timestamp relative to start (timestamp dependency).
addFounder requires msg.sender == admin before allowing founder registration.
The admin state variable is read in the addFounder authorization check.
withdraw uses msg.sender to look up the founder record and to authorize the withdrawal amount.
checkAmountAvailable reads founders[msg.sender].totalAmountLocked using the caller identity.
checkAmountWithdrawn returns founders[msg.sender].amountWithdrawn using the caller identity.
The constructor calls _setWithdrawalSchedule to populate the withdrawal percentages.
The constructor reads block.timestamp to set the immutable start value.
_setWithdrawalSchedule writes cumulative percentages into percentageAvailableByDays.
currentPercentage drives the loop condition and the values written to percentageAvailableByDays.
startDay is the key advanced each loop iteration when writing the schedule.
_founderAddress is used to look up and write the founders mapping in addFounder.
_amountLocked is validated against totalAmountTimelocked and stored in the founder record.
totalAmountTimelocked bounds totalAllocated + _amountLocked in the allocation check.
addFounder writes totalAmountLocked and amountWithdrawn into the founders mapping.
addFounder increments the totalAllocated running counter.
withdraw reads founders[msg.sender].totalAmountLocked and amountWithdrawn to compute the payout.
withdraw uses the immutable start to compute elapsed time and the standard withdrawal day.
withdraw requires amountAvailableForWithdrawal + totalAmountWithdrawn < totalAmountTimelocked.
withdraw indexes percentageAvailableByDays with the computed standardWithdrawalDay.
withdraw reads totalAmountWithdrawn in the global cap check.
currentElapsedTime is derived from block.timestamp - start inside withdraw.
currentElapsedDays feeds the standardWithdrawalDay computation.
standardWithdrawalDay selects the vested percentage from percentageAvailableByDays.
percentageAvailableToOwner is the looked-up vesting percentage used in the amount computation.
amountAvailableToOwner is produced by multiplication/division and feeds the subtraction that yields the payout.
amountAvailableForWithdrawal is the result of amountAvailableToOwner - amountWithdrawn, the core arithmetic step.
owner (msg.sender) is passed as the recipient of the external token transfer.
The caller-supplied token address is used as the target of the external ERC20 call.
withdraw performs the external IERC20(token).transfer call, giving an attacker-controlled token a reentrancy hook.
A malicious token can call back into withdraw during transfer, before totalAmountWithdrawn and the founder's amountWithdrawn are updated.
totalAmountWithdrawn is written only after the external call, enabling repeated withdrawals via reentrancy.
founders[owner].amountWithdrawn is updated after the external call, so the founder record is stale during reentrancy.
withdraw increments totalAmountWithdrawn after the external transfer, an effect that can be bypassed by reentering.
withdraw increments founders[owner].amountWithdrawn after the external transfer, allowing double-spend on reentry.
withdraw computes multiple unsigned subtractions that can underflow or revert depending on elapsed time.
checkAvailability evaluates (_daysElapsed - 7), which underflows for any input below 7.
The externally supplied _daysElapsed flows directly into the unguarded subtraction in checkAvailability.
checkAvailability reads the percentageAvailableByDays schedule with the computed day.
_founder is used to look up founders[_founder].totalAmountLocked.
checkFounderAllocation reads the founders mapping.
_percentAvailable is multiplied by the founder's locked amount in the unchecked-view computation.
checkAmountAvailable reads founders[msg.sender].totalAmountLocked.
checkAmountWithdrawn reads founders[msg.sender].amountWithdrawn.

normalization_plan.reason: The address parameter only exists to key the founders mapping write performed by addFounder.
The amount parameter is validated and stored entirely within addFounder.
The caller-supplied token address exists only to select the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
The founder address parameter is only used for the founders mapping lookup inside checkFounderAllocation.
The elapsed-days parameter is consumed entirely by the day arithmetic in checkAvailability.
The percentage parameter is only used in the arithmetic of checkAmountAvailable.
Intermediate timing value computed and consumed solely inside withdraw.
Intermediate day value computed and consumed solely inside withdraw.
Intermediate index value used only to read the schedule inside withdraw.
Intermediate cached percentage used only to size the withdrawal inside withdraw.
The vested-amount intermediate is consumed by the subtraction-based payout arithmetic in withdraw.
The final payout intermediate is the output of the subtraction arithmetic that precedes the external transfer.
The recipient alias of msg.sender is only used for the transfer inside withdraw.
Loop accumulator confined to the schedule-initialization loop.
Loop day counter confined to the schedule-initialization loop.
